QuestInfo.name: The Fox-Eared People
QuestInfo.0: Ask Cartalion of Pantheon if he knows of any fox-eared people.
QuestInfo.1:
To reach what might be Rondo's hometown, you'll have to go to the edge of the barrier and break through the multitude of Specters there.


#r(If you fail, you can forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Rondo thanked you for coming with him, but neither of you can go any further. One day, when you're stronger, maybe you can help him see it through.
